# Montelibero Association

Canonical site: https://mtla.me/

This is a static multilingual landing page for the Montelibero Association.

Primary entry points:
- Root: https://mtla.me/
- English: https://mtla.me/en/
- Russian: https://mtla.me/ru/
- Spanish: https://mtla.me/es/
- Montenegrin: https://mtla.me/sr/

Key sections on each locale page:
- Hero / overview of the Association
- Agreement
- Governance bodies
- Documents and regulations
- Link to the telegram bot for joining MTLA

Canonical document pages live on docs.mtla.me:
- See their file for LLMs: https://docs.mtla.me/llms.txt
- Agreement (EN): https://docs.mtla.me/Agreement/Agreement.en.html
- Participation regulations: https://docs.mtla.me/Participation/Participation.ru.html
- Principles: https://docs.mtla.me/Principles/Principles.en.html
- All docs in machine-readable registry: https://docs.mtla.me/data.json
